## The validator's ceiling

With every rule of `ARM64.rules` (the derived forms of the proven set included), the validator accepts 77316 of the 96560 functions. Each rejected function counts once, under the first check that rejects it (`whyL`): its class is the reason without value IDs, a rule's reasons one per commutation choice (`nomatch`: the pattern does not match the replayed definitions; `top`/`argsL`: a shape check; `ctrls`: the new block controls; `result`: the built values). Fixing a class gains at most its functions: a function may fail a later check too.
